capabilities: Intercept pastes containing LaTeX math signals and clean the formulas automatically
Convert escaped delimiters (\(...\), \[...\]) and double escapes to $ and $$
Repair HTML entities and Unicode math symbols inside math regions only
Fix existing broken notes with a 'Clean up current note' command
Offer HTML surgery or plain-text paste modes
extras: Pending Obsidian community marketplace review, so manual installation from release assets is required. Documents a known limitation: Obsidian's built-in 'Convert pasted HTML to Markdown' escapes $ signs, so plain-text mode may be needed after HTML pastes. Bilingual UI (English/Chinese).
problem: Copying content from web pages or AI chats pastes formulas with escaped delimiters, HTML entities, and Unicode math symbols that don't render in Obsidian.
summary: Paste interceptor that automatically cleans broken LaTeX formulas from web pages and AI chats while preserving surrounding text formatting.
